2608.27348.title: INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment
2608.27348.paper_summary: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. These findings suggest that action preferences are useful for tracking agentic misalignment during reasoning. Our code and data are accessible: https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool.
2608.27348.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）作為自主代理被部署時，安全失敗越來越多地涉及到後果行動。<lb/>我們研究代理的不一致性，代理在目標衝突和壓力下採取有害行動。<lb/>通過思維鏈（CoT）監控，我們發現有害執行通常在推理中伴隨著意圖信號。然而，事後的CoT標籤過於粗略，無法顯示意圖在生成過程中的變化。<lb/>我們提出了INTENT-AS-A-TOOL，一種添加針對意圖的工具的方法，為模型提供一個專門的渠道來表達對目標行為的承諾。<lb/>調用意圖工具的概率提供了一個無評判、細緻的信號，顯示模型追求該行為的傾向。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，INTENT-AS-A-TOOL補充了CoT監控，將事後的CoT標籤擴展為密集的軌跡，並識別出在線干預的關鍵步驟。<lb/>這些發現表明，行動偏好對於在推理過程中跟踪代理的不一致性是有用的。<lb/>我們的代碼和數據可訪問： https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool。
